        "    js_code = \"\"\"\n",
        "    async function captureImage() {\n",
        "        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({\n",
        "            video: true\n",
        "        });\n",
        "        const video = document.createElement('video');\n",
        "        video.srcObject = stream;\n",
        "        await video.play();\n",
        "        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));\n",
        "        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n",
        "        canvas.width = video.videoWidth;\n",
        "        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;\n",
        "        const context = canvas.getContext('2d');\n",
        "        context.drawImage(video, 0, 0);\n",
        "        stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());\n",
        "        return canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg');\n",
        "    }\n",
        "    captureImage();\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    image_data = eval_js(js_code)\n",
        "    image_bytes = b64decode(image_data.split(',')[1])\n",
        "    with open(\"hand_image.jpg\", \"wb\") as file:\n",
        "        file.write(image_bytes)\n",
        "    frame = cv2.imread(\"hand_image.jpg\")\n",

        "from IPython.display import Image, display, Javascript\n",
        "from google.colab.output import eval_js\n",
        "from base64 import b64decode\n",
        "import time\n",
        "import cv2\n",
        "\n",
        "display_handle = None\n",
        "last_timestamp = 0\n",
        "\n",
        "duration = 60  # Run for 60 seconds\n",
        "start_time = time.time()\n",
        "\n",
        "try:\n",
        "    # Inject globally-scoped JS functions so eval_js can reliably access them\n",
        "    js_redefine = \"\"\"\n",
        "    window.getFrame = async function() {\n",
        "        if (!window.videoStream) {\n",
        "            window.videoStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({\n",
        "                video: true\n",
        "            });\n",
        "\n",
        "            window.videoElement = document.createElement('video');\n",
        "            window.videoElement.srcObject = window.videoStream;\n",
        "            await window.videoElement.play();\n",
        "        }\n",
        "\n",
        "        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n",
        "        canvas.width = window.videoElement.videoWidth;\n",
        "        canvas.height = window.videoElement.videoHeight;\n",
        "\n",
        "        const context = canvas.getContext('2d');\n",
        "        context.drawImage(window.videoElement, 0, 0);\n",
        "\n",
        "        return canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg');\n",
        "    };\n",
        "\n",
        "    window.stopVideo = function() {\n",
        "        if (window.videoStream) {\n",
        "            window.videoStream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());\n",
        "            window.videoStream = null;\n",
        "        }\n",
        "    };\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    display(Javascript(js_redefine))\n",
        "    time.sleep(1) # Give the browser a moment to register\n",
        "\n",
        "    while time.time() - start_time < duration:\n",
        "\n",
        "        image_data = eval_js(\"window.getFrame()\")\n",
        "\n",
        "        image_bytes = b64decode(image_data.split(',')[1])\n",
        "\n",
        "        with open(\"video_frame.jpg\", \"wb\") as file:\n",
        "            file.write(image_bytes)\n",
        "\n",
        "        frame = cv2.imread(\"video_frame.jpg\")\n",
        "\n",
        "        rgb_frame = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)\n",
        "\n",
        "        mp_image = mp.Image(\n",
        "            image_format=mp.ImageFormat.SRGB,\n",
        "            data=rgb_frame\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        timestamp = time.monotonic_ns() // 1000000\n",
        "        timestamp = max(timestamp, last_timestamp + 1)\n",
        "        last_timestamp = timestamp\n",
        "\n",
        "        result = video_recognizer.recognize_for_video(\n",
        "            mp_image, timestamp\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        output_frame = frame.copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "        if result.gestures:\n",
        "            gesture = result.gestures[0][0].category_name\n",
        "            confidence = result.gestures[0][0].score\n",
        "\n",
        "            text = gesture + \" (\" + str(round(confidence * 100, 2)) + \"%)\"\n",
        "\n",
        "            cv2.putText(\n",
        "                output_frame, text, (20, 50),\n",
        "                cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.8,\n",
        "                (0, 255, 0), 2\n",
        "            )\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            cv2.putText(\n",
        "                output_frame, \"No Gesture Detected\",\n",
        "                (20, 50), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,\n",
        "                0.8, (0, 0, 255), 2\n",
        "            )\n",
        "\n",
        "        _, buffer = cv2.imencode(\".jpg\", output_frame)\n",
        "\n",
        "        if display_handle is None:\n",
        "            display_handle = display(\n",
        "                Image(data=buffer.tobytes()),\n",
        "                display_id=True\n",
        "            )\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            display_handle.update(\n",
        "                Image(data=buffer.tobytes())\n",
        "            )\n",
        "\n",
        "        time.sleep(0.1)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"60 seconds completed!\")\n",
        "\n",
        "finally:\n",
        "    try:\n",
        "        eval_js(\"window.stopVideo()\")\n",
        "        print(\"Webcam stopped successfully!\")\n",
        "    except Exception as e:\n",
        "        print(f\"Could not stop webcam: {e}\")"

        "**Conclusion**\n",
        "# The AI-Based Hand Gesture Recognition project was successfully developed using Python, OpenCV, and MediaPipe. The system captures hand movements through a webcam and recognizes different gestures such as Open Palm, Victory, and Closed Fist. It also displays the detected gesture along with its confidence score. Through this project, I learned how to work with computer vision, hand detection, and real-time gesture recognition.
